name: Direct Access to /etc/shadow
description: Detects a process directly referencing /etc/shadow on its command line, a common way to read or copy out hashed local credentials for offline cracking. Linux analog of the LSASS/comsvcs dump rule. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_shadow_file_access.yml, hand-converted from Sigma (no ecs_linux/auditd pysigma pipeline exists, so this EQL targets the real auditbeat auditd-module field shape directly).
false_positives: Legitimate backup/configuration-management tooling that reads /etc/shadow as root
author: Sentinel
